# Conflicting fields keep the primary's value; the primary's gaps fill from the secondary

**Claim.** Scalar fields the two people disagree on keep the primary's value, and fields the primary left empty are filled in from the secondary — so the primary can come out of a merge holding more data than it went in with.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1mergeInto/put`

## Observed exchange

_The two disagree on firstName, and the primary lacks the middleName and occupation the secondary holds._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Beatriz",
  "lastName": "Fontaine-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Bea",
  "middleName": "Lucia",
  "lastName": "Fontaine-{scope}",
  "occupation": "Archivist"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000002
{
  "vanId": 100000002,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
PUT /people/100000002/mergeInto

{
  "vanId": 100000001
}

→ 200
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001
}
```

_The disputed firstName kept the primary's value; the middleName and occupation the primary lacked were filled in from the secondary._
